verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents its own recovery for broken pipelines. It has a dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker so failed events can be replayed, and it buffers data in Kafka during warehouse downtime and delivers it once the warehouse is back. Deduplication also makes resending data safe. Nothing shows replaying archived history into a newly added destination or backfilling a new tool. missing for 10: replay or backfill of archived history into a new destination, documented controls for replay scope and time range, independent or hands-on corroboration of DLQ reprocessing.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks

citations.quote: Dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker: failed events can be replayed instead of lost.
Jitsu will keep your data in a Kafka and deliver it once the warehouse is back online
Send same data as many times as you want. Jitsu will deduplicate it for you
